description:
Scope
Chot domain backend theo mo hinh Exam -> ExamSection -> Question / Media.
ExamSection.type phai ho tro READING, LISTENING, WRITING, SPEAKING.
ListeningSession va ListeningPlaybackEvent la module rieng cho LISTENING section.
Thiet ke ImportJob/worker flow cho giao vien upload file -> parse -> draft exam -> review -> publish.
De xuat API boundary, response format, error format, pagination, auth, authorization, timestamps va ID convention.
Output
Domain diagram moi.
Database schema proposal moi.
Entity relationship list.
API endpoint proposal.
Normalized Exam Schema proposal.
ImportJob + worker flow.
Danh sach schema cu giu, doi, bo.
Acceptance criteria
Mot Exam co the chua nhieu Section.
Question khong phu thuoc truc tiep vao Listening.
Media gan duoc voi Section hoac Question theo thiet ke ro rang.
Attempt tham chieu dung Exam/version hoc sinh da lam.
Answer key khong xuat hien trong response danh cho Student.
File import dung asynchronous job model, khong parse nang trong HTTP request.
title: Finalize Backend Domain Architecture

description:
Scope
Khoi tao backend project TypeScript.
Cau hinh environment, config loader va validation cho bien moi truong.
Ket noi PostgreSQL.
Setup migration system.
Setup Docker cho app va database.
Tao GET /health.
Chuan hoa structure module / service / controller.
Output
Backend chay local bang Docker.
Ket noi DB thanh cong.
GET /health tra 200 OK voi body { status: "ok" }.
Acceptance criteria
Khong hard-code credentials.
Co .env.example.
Migration command chay duoc.
Project co README huong dan chay local.
Chua implement business logic.
title: Setup Backend Foundation

description:
Scope
Tao bang users, roles, user_roles.
users gom username unique, password_hash, status, created_at, updated_at.
Seed roles ADMIN, TEACHER, STUDENT.
Chuan bi relationship cho Student va Teacher profile.
Output
Migration tao user/role schema.
Seed co san 3 roles.
Acceptance criteria
Khong luu plaintext password.
Username unique.
Role seed chay lap lai khong tao duplicate.
Chua lam login API.
title: User And Role Database

description:
Scope
Dinh nghia format success response, error response va validation error.
Dinh nghia pagination format cho list API.
Tao global validation pipe/middleware.
Tao exception filter/error mapper.
Output
Response contract dung chung.
Validation va error response thong nhat.
Acceptance criteria
API loi validation tra field-level errors.
Khong leak stack trace ra client.
Cac endpoint sau nay dung chung contract nay.
title: Global API Contract Validation And Error Handling

description:
Scope
POST /auth/login.
POST /auth/logout.
POST /auth/refresh.
GET /auth/me.
Password hashing.
JWT/session strategy, refresh/session expiry.
Account locked/inactive handling.
Output
Auth API hoat dong cho ADMIN, TEACHER, STUDENT.
Access token va refresh/session flow.
Acceptance criteria
Invalid login tra loi chung, khong tiet lo username hay password sai.
Password compare dung hash.
Inactive/locked account khong login duoc.
GET /auth/me tra current user va roles.
title: Authentication

description:
Scope
Tao guard/middleware kiem tra role.
Enforce permission o backend cho ADMIN, TEACHER, STUDENT.
Dinh nghia route-level permission cho cac module chinh.
Output
RBAC guard dung chung.
Test case cho endpoint can role.
Acceptance criteria
Frontend an button khong duoc xem la security.
User sai role nhan 403.
User chua login nhan 401.
title: Authorization And RBAC

description:
Scope

POST /students, GET /students, GET /students/:id, PATCH /students/:id.
POST /students/:id/reset-password.
PATCH /students/:id/status.

Search, filter, pagination.

Acceptance criteria
Khong duplicate membership.
List API co pagination.
Reset password tao password hash moi.
Status inactive/locked anh huong login va assignment visibility theo rule.

description:
Scope

Exam CRUD cho Teacher/Admin.
Exam response co sections placeholder.
Acceptance criteria
Student khong xem duoc draft exam.
Delete nen la soft delete/archive neu exam da co attempt.
Versioning khong lam hong attempt cu.

description:

File qua size hoac sai MIME bi reject.
Delete xu ly metadata va object storage theo rule.

description:

description:
